question: Within 110 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant aligned with the route to Tradewinds Airport Hotel, Inglewood, CA from the Last House on Mulholland, Los Angeles, CA?
sql: WITH route_points AS ( SELECT (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Last House on Mulholland%' LIMIT 1) AS start_geom, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Tradewinds Airport Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Inglewood%' LIMIT 1) AS end_geom ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, route_points AS rp WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, rp.start_geom::geography, 110000) -- Fast food is within 110 kilometers of the starting point AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(rp.start_geom, rp.end_geom)::geography, 1000)); -- Fast food is aligned with the route (within 1km buffer of the straight line)
